audience: HR teams with authorized TalentHR API access

useCases.title: Review team availability
useCases.text: Read the team calendar and an employee’s pending or approved leave requests.

useCases.title: Check leave balances
useCases.text: Read an employee’s budget and usage for the current or a selected time-off cycle.

useCases.title: Review headcount trends
useCases.text: Compare company headcount, hires and leavers for a selected reporting period.

useCases.title: Book agreed time off
useCases.text: Create an employee’s time-off request. The manager is emailed for a decision unless preapproval is explicitly chosen and permitted.

useCases.title: Respond to pending leave
useCases.text: Approve or reject a selected pending request when authorized. TalentHR emails the employee the decision.

useCases.title: Record a recruiting note
useCases.text: Add an internal note to a selected job application for the hiring team.
